_comment: Minimum number of tests the suite must report, and how many of them may be skipped. Raise the floor when you add tests; never lower it without saying why in the commit message. A run that reports fewer than this FAILS, even if every test it did run passed — see scripts/check-test-floor.mjs for why. maxSkipped stops the floor from being met by skipped tests: the only conditionally-skipped file today is tests/integration/delivery-queue-redis.test.ts (5 tests), which runs when TEST_REDIS_URL is set.
